verdict.rationale: Cal.com's app directory says the Outlook integration checks that calendar for conflicts, and the product pitch is to 'connect your calendars' so people can pick a time. The slots API also references busy-time calculations. Google and Apple Calendar appear only as app listings with generic descriptions, and nothing states that several connected calendars are checked together to prevent double-booking. missing for 10: explicit conflict checking for Google and Apple calendars, documentation that multiple connected calendars are all checked at once, independent or hands-on corroboration of double-booking prevention

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can connect several calendars (Google, Outlook, Apple) and every one is checked for conflicts so I never get double-booked

citations.quote: Check your Outlook calendar for conflicts and add your bookings to it.
Share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth.
provide the booking's unique identifier to exclude its time slot from busy time calculations.
